genes.name: HLA Class II DR Beta 1
genes.function: Antigen presentation to CD4+ T cells via MHC class II
genes.ra_evidence: Shared epitope alleles (QKRAA/QRRAA/RRRAA at positions 70-74) are the strongest genetic risk factor for RA, especially ACPA+ disease. *0401, *0404, *0101 alleles confer 3-5x increased risk.

genes.name: Protein Tyrosine Phosphatase N22 (LYP)
genes.function: Negative regulator of T cell receptor and B cell receptor signaling
genes.ra_evidence: R620W (rs2476601) gain-of-function variant is the strongest non-HLA risk factor for RA (OR 1.8). Alters TCR signaling thresholds and Treg function.

genes.name: Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 4
genes.function: Mediates IL-12 and type I IFN signaling; promotes Th1 and Th17 differentiation
genes.ra_evidence: rs7574865 risk allele associated with RA susceptibility (OR 1.3). Shared risk with SLE and Sjögren's syndrome.

genes.name: TNF Alpha Induced Protein 3 (A20)
genes.function: Ubiquitin-editing enzyme that negatively regulates NF-κB signaling
genes.ra_evidence: Polymorphisms in TNFAIP3 region associated with RA. A20 limits TNF-induced NF-κB activation in synovial fibroblasts.

genes.name: Cytotoxic T-Lymphocyte Associated Protein 4
genes.function: Inhibitory receptor on T cells that competes with CD28 for B7 binding, dampening T cell activation
genes.ra_evidence: CTLA4 polymorphisms associated with RA. The therapeutic CTLA4-Ig fusion (abatacept) is an approved RA biologic.

genes.name: TRAF1 / Complement C5 Locus
genes.function: TRAF1: TNF receptor-associated factor regulating NF-κB. C5: Complement component C5.
genes.ra_evidence: rs10818488 at TRAF1/C5 locus associated with RA risk (OR 1.2). Links TNF signaling and complement activation.

genes.name: Interleukin-6 Receptor
genes.function: Receptor for IL-6; mediates pro-inflammatory signaling via JAK1/JAK2-STAT3 and soluble gp130 trans-signaling
genes.ra_evidence: IL6R polymorphisms associated with RA. IL-6 is a central pathogenic cytokine; tocilizumab (anti-IL-6R) is a highly effective RA therapy.

genes.name: C-C Chemokine Receptor 6
genes.function: Chemokine receptor directing Th17 cell migration to inflamed tissues
genes.ra_evidence: CCR6 variant rs3093024 associated with RA risk. CCR6+ Th17 cells infiltrate the rheumatoid synovium.

genes.name: Peptidyl Arginine Deiminase 4
genes.function: Catalyzes citrullination of arginine residues; generates autoantigens recognized by anti-CCP antibodies
genes.ra_evidence: PADI4 haplotypes associated with RA, especially in Asian populations. PADI4 is a key enzyme generating citrullinated autoantigens in the rheumatoid joint.

genes.name: Fc Gamma Receptor IIA (CD32)
genes.function: Low-affinity IgG Fc receptor mediating immune complex clearance and phagocytosis
genes.ra_evidence: FCGR2A H131R polymorphism associated with RA. Altered IgG binding affects immune complex clearance in the joint.

genes.name: Interferon Regulatory Factor 5
genes.function: Transcription factor driving type I IFN and proinflammatory cytokine expression
genes.ra_evidence: IRF5 polymorphisms associated with RA and other autoimmune diseases. Drives IFN signature that overlaps with SLE.

genes.name: CD40 (TNFRSF5)
genes.function: Costimulatory receptor on B cells and APCs; binds CD40L (CD154) on T cells to drive germinal center responses
genes.ra_evidence: CD40 polymorphisms associated with RA. The CD40-CD40L axis drives B cell activation and autoantibody production in RA synovium.

genes.name: Interleukin-2 Receptor Alpha Chain (CD25)
genes.function: High-affinity IL-2 receptor subunit; critical for Treg development and maintenance
genes.ra_evidence: IL2RA polymorphisms associated with RA and other autoimmune diseases. Altered IL-2 signaling impairs Treg function.

genes.name: Interleukin-2 Receptor Beta Chain (CD122)
genes.function: Shared receptor subunit for IL-2 and IL-15 signaling in T cells and NK cells
genes.ra_evidence: IL2RB locus associated with RA. IL-15 is elevated in RA synovial fluid and drives T cell and NK cell activation.

genes.name: PR Domain Zinc Finger Protein 1 (BLIMP-1)
genes.function: Master transcriptional regulator of plasma cell differentiation
genes.ra_evidence: PRDM1 polymorphisms associated with RA. BLIMP-1 drives B cell differentiation into antibody-secreting plasma cells in RA synovium.

genes.name: IKAROS Family Zinc Finger 3 (AIOLOS)
genes.function: Transcription factor regulating B cell differentiation and plasma cell function
genes.ra_evidence: IKZF3 polymorphisms associated with RA. AIOLOS is required for long-lived plasma cell maintenance.

genes.name: c-Rel Proto-Oncogene
genes.function: NF-κB family transcription factor; critical for Treg development, B cell survival, and inflammatory cytokine production
genes.ra_evidence: c-Rel polymorphisms associated with RA. c-Rel regulates multiple inflammatory genes in RA synovial fibroblasts.

genes.name: Tyrosine Kinase 2
genes.function: JAK family kinase mediating type I IFN, IL-12, and IL-23 signaling
genes.ra_evidence: TYK2 polymorphisms associated with RA, SLE, and psoriasis. Mediates pathogenic IL-12/23-driven Th1/Th17 responses.

genes.name: Ankyrin Repeat Domain 55
genes.function: Regulates T cell activation and IL-2 production via NF-κB pathway modulation
genes.ra_evidence: ANKRD55 polymorphisms associated with RA and MS. Functions in CD4+ T cell activation.

genes.name: Matrix Metalloproteinase 9 (Gelatinase B)
genes.function: Degrades extracellular matrix components; key mediator of joint destruction and angiogenesis in RA
genes.ra_evidence: MMP9 is highly expressed in RA synovium and synovial fluid. Correlates with radiographic progression and joint erosion.

genes.name: Tumor Necrosis Factor Alpha
genes.function: Master pro-inflammatory cytokine driving synovial inflammation, osteoclast activation, and cartilage degradation
genes.ra_evidence: TNF promoter polymorphisms associated with RA severity. TNF is the dominant cytokine in RA synovium. Anti-TNF biologics transformed RA treatment.

genes.name: CD28 Costimulatory Receptor
genes.function: Primary T cell costimulatory receptor binding B7.1/B7.2 (CD80/CD86) on APCs
genes.ra_evidence: CD28 expression is dysregulated in RA T cells. CD28null T cells accumulate in RA and produce proinflammatory cytokines.

genes.name: B Lymphoid Tyrosine Kinase
genes.function: Src family kinase involved in B cell receptor signaling and tolerance
genes.ra_evidence: BLK polymorphisms shared across multiple autoimmune diseases including RA. Reduced BLK expression alters BCR signaling.

genes.name: B Cell Scaffold Protein with Ankyrin Repeats 1
genes.function: Scaffold protein modulating BCR-induced calcium mobilization and signaling
genes.ra_evidence: BANK1 polymorphisms associated with RA, SLE, and systemic sclerosis. Regulates B cell hyperresponsiveness.

genes.name: Receptor Activator of NF-κB Ligand (TNFSF11)
genes.function: Essential cytokine for osteoclast differentiation and activation; drives bone erosion in inflammatory arthritis
genes.ra_evidence: RANKL is highly expressed in RA synovium by T cells and synovial fibroblasts. Denosumab (anti-RANKL) reduces bone erosion in RA.

genes.name: CD20 (MS4A1 / B-lymphocyte antigen CD20)
genes.function: B cell surface protein involved in B cell activation, proliferation, and calcium signaling
genes.disease_evidence: Target of B cell depletion therapies (rituximab, obinutuzumab) used clinically in refractory SLE.

genes.name: CD80
genes.function: Abatacept (CTLA4-Ig) binds CD80/CD86 on APCs, blocking CD28-mediated T cell costimulation
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: CD86
genes.function: Abatacept (CTLA4-Ig) binds CD80/CD86 on APCs, blocking CD28-mediated T cell costimulation
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: Calcineurin (PPP3CA / Protein Phosphatase 3)
genes.function: Calcium/calmodulin-dependent serine/threonine phosphatase; dephosphorylates NFAT enabling T cell activation
genes.disease_evidence: Target of voclosporin and tacrolimus for lupus nephritis; also stabilizes podocyte actin cytoskeleton in kidney.

genes.name: DHFR
genes.function: Methotrexate inhibits DHFR and AICAR transformylase, leading to adenosine accumulation with anti-inflammatory effects
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: DHODH
genes.function: Leflunomide inhibits DHODH, blocking de novo pyrimidine synthesis and proliferating T lymphocytes
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: Glucocorticoid Receptor (NR3C1)
genes.function: Nuclear receptor that mediates anti-inflammatory effects via transrepression of NF-κB and AP-1, and induction of anti-inflammatory genes
genes.disease_evidence: Target of prednisone and all corticosteroids, the mainstay of acute SLE management. Goal is to minimize exposure due to toxicity.

genes.name: IL-1 Receptor
genes.function: Anakinra is recombinant IL-1Ra that competitively blocks IL-1α/IL-1β binding to IL-1R1
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: IMPDH (Inosine Monophosphate Dehydrogenase)
genes.function: Rate-limiting enzyme in de novo guanine nucleotide synthesis; essential for lymphocyte proliferation
genes.disease_evidence: Target of mycophenolate mofetil, a first-line therapy for lupus nephritis.

genes.name: Janus Kinase 1
genes.function: Tyrosine kinase mediating signaling for type I/II cytokine receptors
genes.disease_evidence: Required for IFN-α/β, IL-6, and other proinflammatory cytokine signaling. Target of baricitinib and tofacitinib in SLE trials.

genes.name: JAK2
genes.function: Baricitinib inhibits JAK2, which mediates signaling for GM-CSF, EPO, TPO, and growth hormone receptors
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: JAK3
genes.function: Tofacitinib inhibits JAK3 which pairs with JAK1 to mediate IL-2, IL-4, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15, and IL-21 signaling
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: Toll-Like Receptor 7
genes.function: Endosomal sensor of single-stranded RNA; drives type I IFN production in plasmacytoid DCs
genes.disease_evidence: Gene duplication and gain-of-function mutations cause lupus in mice and humans. Key driver of the IFN signature.

genes.name: Toll-Like Receptor 9
genes.function: Endosomal sensor of unmethylated CpG DNA; activates B cells and pDCs
genes.disease_evidence: Recognizes DNA-containing immune complexes; contributes to anti-dsDNA antibody production.
